t: A cheap chip with Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth, Thread and Zigbee for smart home gadgets.
steps: Buy an ESP32-C6 board from a maker shop, such as a thumb-sized or Feather-size board.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Add the ESP32 board package in the Arduino board manager.
Pick your board and its USB port in the menus.
Turn on USB CDC On Boot for boards with only one USB port.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light.
Try the WiFiScan example to list nearby networks.
meta: Open Board. From $5.20. A few stores.
